entries.title: Campaign World Builder
entries.summary: Optional campaign/world map artwork for the modern dashboard and Campaign Management page.
entries.hover: Local-only artwork slot. Put licensed or personal-use art at DATA_DIR/assets/rules_art/local/dashboard_campaign_worldbuilder.png to show it in the dashboard.

entries.title: Home Dashboard Artwork
entries.summary: Optional dashboard home artwork. Replace the matching DATA_DIR/assets/Application Artwork placeholder with this GIF.
entries.hover: Used by the modern dashboard home Relevant Artwork panel. The app checks DATA_DIR/assets/Application Artwork/home_dashboard_1600x900.gif first.

entries.title: Character Management Artwork
entries.summary: Optional character management artwork for the dashboard section.
entries.hover: Used by Character Management. Supply a 1600 x 900 GIF in DATA_DIR/assets/Application Artwork.

entries.title: Troupe Management Artwork
entries.summary: Optional Troupe Management artwork. This is the slot shown in that page's Relevant Artwork panel.
entries.hover: Used by Troupe Management. Replace DATA_DIR/assets/Application Artwork/troupe_management_1600x900_REPLACE_WITH_GIF.txt with troupe_management_1600x900.gif.

entries.title: Guild Management Artwork
entries.summary: Optional Guild Management artwork for guild records, jobs, and finance surfaces.
entries.hover: Used by Guild Management. Supply local or licensed art only; printed TAG rules remain referenced, not copied.

entries.title: Party Management Artwork
entries.summary: Optional Party Management artwork for saved-party and troupe assignment screens.
entries.hover: Used by Party Management. The app marks the slot missing until party_management_1600x900.gif exists in DATA_DIR/assets/Application Artwork.

entries.title: Equipment and Shop Artwork
entries.summary: Optional Equipment and Shop artwork.
entries.hover: Used by Equipment and Shop. Supply a 1600 x 900 GIF for local shop or gear artwork.

entries.title: Banking and Finance Artwork
entries.summary: Optional Banking and Finance artwork for accounts, troves, and storage guidance.
entries.hover: Used by Banking and Finance. Keep financial rules text in the Rules Reference; this slot is image-only.

entries.title: Settlement Management Artwork
entries.summary: Optional friendly settlement artwork for Settlement Management.
entries.hover: Used by Settlement Management. This is for friendly towns; future troublesome-town slots should be separate.

entries.title: Campaign Management Artwork
entries.summary: Optional Campaign Management artwork for the world-builder surface.
entries.hover: Used by Campaign Management. This is app world-builder artwork, not a TAG printed rule.

entries.title: Adventure Management Artwork
entries.summary: Optional Adventure Management artwork for module import/export/delete screens.
entries.hover: Used by Adventure Management. The manager blocks deleting modules currently in use; this slot is only presentation art.

entries.title: Go Adventure Artwork
entries.summary: Optional Go Adventure artwork for start, resume, and generation workflows.
entries.hover: Used by Go Adventure. Automation still follows source boundaries: app rolls fixed rolls, player chooses printed choices.

entries.title: Rules Reference Artwork
entries.summary: Optional Rules Reference artwork.
entries.hover: Used by Rules Reference. Artwork should support navigation; rules text must stay in referenced summaries unless explicitly licensed.

entries.title: Tables List Artwork
entries.summary: Optional Tables List artwork.
entries.hover: Used by the modern Tables page. Table data remains separately verified by tests and rule references.

entries.title: PDF Library and Background Artwork
entries.summary: Optional PDF Library and Background artwork.
entries.hover: Used by the PDF Library page. Personal PDF crops should stay in DATA_DIR/assets unless publication rights are secured.

entries.title: Game Guides Artwork
entries.summary: Optional Game Guides artwork.
entries.hover: Used by Game Guides. This slot is for guide illustration, not copied PDF instructions.

entries.title: Settings and Options Artwork
entries.summary: Optional Settings and Options artwork.
entries.hover: Used by Settings / Options. The page controls ruleset/profile behavior; this slot is presentation-only.

entries.title: Developer Section Artwork
entries.summary: Optional Developer section artwork, including the Artwork Manager.
entries.hover: Used by Developer. Developer tools list asset status and paths; they do not grant publication rights.

entries.title: Adventurers Guild Workflow
entries.summary: Optional TAG guild artwork or page crop for Guild Management and TAG lead creation.
entries.hover: Use this for licensed or private TAG Guild art. Do not commit extracted PDF art unless you have publication rights.

entries.title: TAG Settlement Services
entries.summary: Optional settlement/services artwork for TAG banking, availability, and travel surfaces.
entries.hover: Local artwork slot for TAG settlement service art. The UI still works when the file is absent.

entries.title: Expanded Edition Dungeon Tables
entries.summary: Optional artwork/page crop for the core dungeon table browsing surface.
entries.hover: Suggested use: a small licensed or private-use crop that reminds the user which rulebook section the tables come from.

entries.title: Forsaken Depths Map Elements
entries.summary: Optional Forsaken Depths tile artwork for table validation and map-editor workflows.
entries.hover: Local-only art slot for FD tile/page artwork. Keep generated PDF crops out of git unless licensed for publication.

entries.title: Troublesome Towns
entries.summary: Future artwork slot for troublesome town campaign records.
entries.hover: Planned slot for the future Troublesome Towns supplements. No supplement mechanics are implemented here yet.
